$Comment: HARDCORE preset (partial overlay, decoded via MobScalingSettingsAsset.CODEC). Only the keys that differ from Default; omitted leaves fall through to the jar Default via the per-leaf fold. Selected by setting ActivePreset:"Hardcore" (owner file or /mobscaling preset Hardcore). Harsher than an even fight: the toughness slope and the damage scale are 1.4 times Default's (the damage shape is inherited, so the curve keeps its bend), so a plain mob at a player's own power is already a step ahead of them and a Rare is a real threat, and the two rails sit just past a Boss at this preset's own top of the scale (the same rule Default uses). Dense specials, a wider group swing, and a distance escalation that begins close to spawn and runs to the full cap, which sits about 17,000 blocks out from the highest shipped zone floor.
Name: Hardcore
